export_evidence: No export (outbound) shipment record was found for SHAH NANJI NAGSI OVERSEAS PRIVATE LIMITED. The only populated customs dataset found on ImportKey is for the differently-named entity SHAH NANJI NAGSI EXPORTS PRIVATE LIMITED, and every visible row is an IMPORT INTO INDIA, not an export. Exact evidence lines (ImportKey, https://importkey.com/countries/india/shah-nanji-nagsi-exports-private-limited): "Total Shipments 184 Records detected ... Latest Cargo 2025-12-08"; row 1: "2025-12-08 COPERAGUAS COOPERATIVA AGROINDUSTRIAL SHAH NANJI NAGSI EXPORTS PRIVATE LIMITED BLACK MATPE (URAD) RAW PULSES ... Paranagua, Brazil CHENNAI SEA, India 07133110 6174450"; row 2: "2025-10-27 RITIKA INTERNATIONAL PTE LTD ... YANGON, Myanmar Chennai Sea, India 7133110 1047540"; row 3: "2025-08-27 WEAVER HYBRIDS QOZB LLC ... NEW YORK, UNITED STATES BOMBAY AIR CARGO, India 10051000 4140414"; row 4: "2025-08-18 NATAIS SAS ... PARIS CHARLES DE G, FRANCE MIHAN ICD, India 10059030 3943394". Direction is origin=foreign country, destination=Indian port (Chennai Sea / Bombay Air Cargo / Mihan ICD), i.e. inbound. Source counter: page claims 184 shipments; only 4 rows were actually rendered in the free view, all inbound. No outbound B/L with an Indian origin port and a foreign destination was seen for either entity.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award, contract or annual-report revenue split could be retrieved. The ImportKey page for the 'Overseas' slug (https://importkey.com/countries/india/shah-nanji-nagsi-overseas-pvt-ltd) returned only a paywall shell with no rows: "Join ImportKey to view the import and export data records of companies all over the world." No shipment count, no dates, no counterparties were displayed. Domestic supply activity is therefore not established either way; recorded as unknown rather than none_found because the absence is a data-access gap, not a verified absence.
note: CRITICAL NAME MISMATCH: the batch record is for SHAH NANJI NAGSI OVERSEAS PRIVATE LIMITED, but the only customs data that exists publicly is under SHAH NANJI NAGSI EXPORTS PRIVATE LIMITED (address on record: "SHAH NANJI NAGSI BUILDING, ITWARI" — Itwari is Nagpur, Maharashtra). These are two distinct legal entities; shipment evidence for one cannot be attributed to the other. Do not merge them without a registry check (MCA) confirming common ownership. SECOND CRITICAL POINT: the 184-record dataset is IMPORT data — this group is buying raw pulses (black matpe/urad, HS 07133110) from Brazil and Myanmar and popcorn/maize seed (HS 10051000, 10059030) from the USA and France into Chennai Sea, Bombay Air Cargo and Mihan ICD. That is inbound trade, not export. Declared HS 100829 (buckwheat/millet-type cereal) does not match any observed line; observed codes are 07133110, 10051000, 10059030 — but per project rules an HS mismatch is NOT grounds for rejection, only for correction. No export shipments, no domestic supply evidence, no revenue figure and no export volume could be verified — all left null rather than estimated. Search backend (DuckDuckGo/searx) was down for the entire session (connection refused), and volza, eximpedia, trademo returned HTTP 403 while importgenius served a JavaScript challenge, so second-source cross-checking was not possible. Recommend re-running this company once search is restored and once MCA confirms whether the Overseas and Exports entities are the same group.
